🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

1. Global Risk Regime?
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 7/11 sectors positive. Mixed signals confirm neutrality: SPY (1W: -1.28% | 1M: -1.25%) BELOW TREND and QQQ (1W: -1.27% | 1M: -2.85%) BELOW TREND show equity softness while TLT (1W: +2.49% | 1M: +1.96%) ↑ rising ABOVE TREND and GLD (1W: +1.57% | 1M: +8.61%) ↑ rising ABOVE TREND show safe‑haven bid.

2. Primary Risk Drivers?
Fear rising: VXX (1W: +5.90% | 1M: +7.81%) ↑ rising ABOVE TREND. Credit modestly firm: HYG (1W: +0.05% | 1M: +0.26%) ABOVE TREND and LQD (1W: +0.93% | 1M: +0.88%) ABOVE TREND. Equity weakness in core indices (SPY/QQQ BELOW TREND) contrasts with commodity/FX strength (GLD ABOVE TREND).

3. Financial Conditions Signal?
Neutral overall: Dollar readings flat and yield signals neutral while TLT (1W: +2.49% | 1M: +1.96%) ↑ rising ABOVE TREND signals bond appetite; curve and liquidity measures show no clear directional push.

📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

4. Sector Leadership?
Cyclicals and commodities showing strength: XLE (1W: +2.07% | 1M: +13.09%) ABOVE TREND and XLB (1W: +3.49% | 1M: +9.35%) ABOVE TREND. Tech lagging: XLK (1W: -1.11% | 1M: -3.55%) BELOW TREND. Style: cyclicals/materials leadership vs growth weakness.

5. US vs Global?
US underperforming selective global pockets: SPY (1W: -1.28% | 1M: -1.25%) BELOW TREND while EEM (1W: +1.75% | 1M: +5.84%) ↑ rising ABOVE TREND and EWJ (1W: +4.98% | 1M: +10.36%) ABOVE TREND; China weak: FXI (1W: -2.27% | 1M: -4.27%) BELOW TREND.

6. Speculative Appetite?
Muted: ARKK (1W: -0.23% | 1M: -15.56%) BELOW TREND and IBIT (1W: -1.79% | 1M: -29.71%) BELOW TREND show risk‑on speculation cooling; IWM (1W: -0.78% | 1M: -0.09%) BELOW TREND, not leading.

🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

7. Commodities Theme?
Gold strong: GLD (1W: +1.57% | 1M: +8.61%) ABOVE TREND. Industrial metals weak: CPER (1W: -1.88% | 1M: -5.17%) BELOW TREND; watch for continued divergence between precious metals and base metals.

8. Energy Trend?
Bifurcated: XLE (1W: +2.07% | 1M: +13.09%) ABOVE TREND shows energy strength while nat gas UNG (1W: -6.25% | 1M: +21.48%) is in CORRECTION — large 1W vs 1M divergence; BNO (1W: -0.41% | 1M: +6.09%) CORRECTION as well.

🧭 STRATEGY

9. Trend Confirmation?
CONFIRMED: TLT (1W: +2.49% | 1M: +1.96%) ABOVE TREND and GLD (1W: +1.57% | 1M: +8.61%) ABOVE TREND. DIVERGENCE: multiple commodities (UNG, BNO) in CORRECTION show 1W weakness vs 1M strength — monitor for mean reversion.

10. Portfolio Direction?
Favor cyclicals/resource exposure (XLE, XLB) given breadth and commodity strength; reduce exposure to lagging tech (XLK) and monitor bond/gold protection (TLT, GLD) as hedges in a neutral backdrop.

🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Sectors to Watch?
BULLISH: XLE (1W: +2.07% | 1M: +13.09%) ABOVE TREND; XLB (1W: +3.49% | 1M: +9.35%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: XLK (1W: -1.11% | 1M: -3.55%) BELOW TREND; QQQ (1W: -1.27% | 1M: -2.85%) BELOW TREND.

12. Commodities to Watch?
BULLISH: GLD (1W: +1.57% | 1M: +8.61%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: CPER (1W: -1.88% | 1M: -5.17%) BELOW TREND. Watch CORRECTION names UNG (1W: -6.25% | 1M: +21.48%) and BNO (1W: -0.41% | 1M: +6.09%).

13. Key Levels?
VXX (1W: +5.90% | 1M: +7.81%) — watch ~20 as fear pivot. HYG (1W: +0.05% | 1M: +0.26%) and LQD (1W: +0.93% | 1M: +0.88%) — monitor HYG/LQD for credit stress signals. XLK (1W: -1.11% | 1M: -3.55%) — watch near prior support for tech leadership test.

📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL: Breadth: 7/11 sectors positive, with mixed risk/cycle signals producing a stalemate. Energy and materials (XLE, XLB) and safe havens (TLT, GLD) showing relative strength. Key risk is sustained tech weakness (XLK BELOW TREND) and commodity divergences (UNG CORRECTION) that could tip sentiment.
